card.name: Space before a duration number
card.fires_on: The space token right after 'for', 'every', 'within', 'to' or 'approximately' when a number of weeks or hours comes next. It appears in dosing-schedule and treatment-length text.

modes.label: Treatment length
modes.description: Space after 'for', 'within' or 'to' before a number of weeks of therapy.
modes.example: 20 mg once daily for<< >>4 weeks 10 mg once daily

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: Space after 'every' or 'approximately' before an interval number.
modes.example: 300 mg (one 300 mg injection) every<< >>4 weeks (Q4W) Dos
